name: Default
shortDescription: Zero-trust access management with WireGuard VPN, MFA and an OpenID Connect identity provider, deployed as Core, Edge and PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: The first visitor creates the admin account in the setup wizard, so finish it right after deploying. Use https://<your domain> as the Defguard URL, https://edge.<your domain> as the public Edge URL, choose "Do not configure SSL" for both, and adopt the Edge at host defguard-edge, gRPC port 50051. Edge accepts adoption for 60 minutes after it starts; restart the defguard-edge service if that window has passed.
The WireGuard Gateway is not part of this stack: it needs NET_ADMIN and a public UDP port, so deploy it on your VPN host and make its gRPC port 50066 reachable from this server before adopting it.
